# Held-out meeting-note fixture

Authored synthetic ProseMirror document with a bold astral-character prefix, replaceable middle and italic suffix. Shift+Enter creates schema `hard_break` nodes. The exact cooperating bridge is served separately from Luda; no DOM setter or fixture shortcut performs the agent's edit. Save posts an independent model, selection, marks and trusted-event oracle to the private harness. No toggle-bold shortcut is installed.

The agent only sees the rendered app and public tools. Its task prompt is in `scripts/agent_hard_break_eval.py`. This fixture contains no credentials or real application data.

Rebuild the offline bundle with `npm ci && npm run build` in this directory. The lockfile pins dependencies, and `bundle-identity.json` records the app source, bundle, lockfile and external bridge SHA256 values used in the retained attempt. `node_modules` is neither tracked nor packaged. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for bundled dependency notices.
